annotations.title: Describe server capabilities and account entitlements

description: Call this FIRST, before anything else: a read-only, unmetered summary of what this MCP server can build (every kind of artifact it speaks and the tools for each), what THIS account's tier allows right now (plan, feature flags, usage budgets with remaining, which Styles are unlocked), and exactly how to get more. Handles every auth state explicitly — a real account, a guest trial, or a self-hosted server with nothing metered — so a limit is never discovered by hitting it.
name: describe_capabilities
